cohort: Deliveries in Sweden (January 1, 2004 to December 31, 2016; n = 1,392,779) and British Columbia (BC), Canada (March 1, 2004 to April 31, 2017; n = 559,205)
finding: Several factors not included in the Robson classification, such as maternal age, BMI, and obstetric practices, explain a significant proportion of the spatiotemporal difference in CD rates in some Robson groups.
